article.story: ASHEVILLE, N.C. -- — Toyaz Solomon had 24 points in UNC Asheville's 95-81 victory against North Florida on Tuesday night. Solomon also had nine rebounds and three steals for the Bulldogs (7-4). Jordan Marsh scored 19 points while shooting 6 for 11 (3 for 5 from 3-point range) and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line and added eight rebounds and seven assists. Greg Gantt shot 5 of 6 from the field and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 13 points, while adding 10 rebounds, eight assists, and three steals. Nate Lliteras led the Ospreys (7-5) in scoring, finishing with 16 points and two steals. North Florida also got 15 points and seven rebounds from Jasai Miles. Oscar Berry had 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
